## What

- [ ] New template / team / skill / routine / pattern
- [ ] CLI or schema
- [ ] Docs

## Contract

- [ ] `template.yaml` is the source of truth (no hand-edited PROFILE.md)
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally
- [ ] Schema and safety validation passes for new stable templates
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, or internal URLs
- [ ] Week-one autonomy is L1 unless a routine + missing-source policy exists
